name: @rootlco/api
description: RootLco backend application — the HTTP API, domain modules and server foundation. Independent package boundary; see docs/adr/ADR-001-modular-monolith.md.
comment:dependencies: Declared at the versions the repository root already resolved, never re-ranged. This package must be able to build and run on its own, so it names what it imports; the root package still declares the same runtime for the repository-level test tiers, which import API source through the @/ alias. Removing the duplicates from the root is a separate, verified step — an unverified removal would break `npm test` in a way no static check would catch. Security overrides stay at the root, which is the only place npm honours them.
